component.name: Patchouli
component.summary: Personal literature manager for large PDF libraries

description.p: Patchouli is an experimental desktop literature manager for managing, digitizing, continuously correcting, and effectively recalling large PDF libraries, with reproducible evidence citations and AI agent collaboration.

It tracks PDF files by content hash instead of moving or renaming them, keeps OCR corrections in an immutable page-level bounding-box tree, and ships an MCP server so AI agents can explore and maintain your library.
